name: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration
definition: Optimizes voxel opacity ($\sigma$) and spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients using gradient-based optimizers with specific learning rate schedules.
summary: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration defines hyperparameters and learning rate schedules to efficiently train static voxel grids with spherical harmonics, distinguished by its use of RMSProp and fixed-resolution grids rather than neural backpropagation or hierarchical octrees.
